learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge on 8/32-bit Microcontroller (uC) Personal Computer (PC) technology and its history.
Acquire knowledge on 8/32-bit Microcontroller (uC) Personal Computer system architecture and internal structure.
Learn the block diagram of microprocessor hardware, CPU module, and memory blocks.
Learn microprocessor assembly languages, compilers, simulators, and emulators.
Learn program analysis, design, and debugging in Personal Computer integrated development software.
Learn by carrying out basic industrial project applications.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Personal Computer (PC) Systems, Historical development, PC-Based System Technologies.
Personal Computer (PC) structure and operation. System Architecture and programming modes.
Personal Computer (PC) Central Processing Unit (CPU) Module Design, Main Memory System.
Block diagrams of Personal Computer (PC) Based Systems.
Personal Computer (PC) Based System Hardware and Software Development Systems.
Personal Computer (PC) Based System Programming Techniques.
Personal Computer (PC) Based System Input/Output and Peripherals.
